address: 51 Stockport Road, Lydgate, Oldham, OL4 4JJ, United Kingdom
bio: This 18C stone pub on the moor is a place that constantly evolves. It’s usually busy but the staff have everything under control and there are comfy bedrooms for those wishing to stay. Dining takes place in the cosy Tap Room or smart brasserie; the appealing menu has a British heart and global influences....
